name: contract_service_dates
summary: Adds separate Service Start Date and Service End Date fields to contract lines, so the actual service period can differ from the billing dates. The dates fill in from the line start and end dates automatically but can be overridden by hand. They appear in a Service Dates group on the Recurrence tab of a contract line.

name: contract_termination
summary: Lets users terminate a contract with a reason, comment and date using a Terminate Contract button. Once terminated, the contract becomes read-only and shows an alert with the termination details, and the termination can be updated or cancelled to reactivate the contract. Termination reasons are set up under Contracts configuration, and only users with the Can Terminate Contracts right can do this.

name: contract_transmit_method
summary: Adds a transmission method, such as email, post or portal, to contracts and contract templates. The chosen method is carried over to the invoices created from the contract, so invoices go out the way the customer expects. The field appears on the contract form.

name: contract_update_last_date_invoiced
summary: Adds a wizard to reset the last invoiced date on a contract line, for example after invoices were deleted, so the next recurring invoice is generated from the correct date. It is opened from the customer contracts list and also lets you set the next invoice date.

name: contract_variable_qty_prorated
summary: Adds a prorated quantity formula for contract lines with a variable quantity, so a partial billing period is invoiced in proportion to the days covered. It only adds the formula; the variable quantity setup itself comes from the contract variable quantity module. It is used on recurring contract invoicing lines.

name: contract_variable_qty_timesheet
summary: Lets a recurring contract line be invoiced from the hours recorded on timesheets, using project timesheets, task timesheets or analytic lines. You pick one of the timesheet quantity types on a recurring invoicing line, and the invoiced quantity comes from the logged time. It is set up on the Contracts recurring invoicing lines.

name: contract_variable_quantity
summary: Lets recurring contract lines have a quantity that changes with each invoice, calculated by a formula the admin defines once under Contracts configuration, Formulas. Choosing the Variable quantity type on a recurring line makes the formula set how much is invoiced. Contracts can also be set to skip lines whose computed quantity is zero.

name: partner_contract_anniversary
summary: Adds a Contracts tab on customer and contact records showing the first contract start date and the contract anniversary date for the current year. Users can filter contacts by anniversary date, which helps plan renewals and customer outreach.

name: product_contract
summary: Lets products be sold as contracts. Selecting a contract template on a product and confirming a sales order creates a contract for it, with the recurrence and renewal rules set on the product. Contract products are not invoiced directly on the sales order, because the recurring contract handles billing, and the sales order shows a contract count.

name: product_contract_recurrence_in_price
summary: Adds an option on contract products to show the total of all planned invoices in the sales order line. A product that costs 10 per month for a year then shows 120 as its total instead of 10. It can be set on the product or per line in the contract configurator.

name: product_contract_section
summary: Copies sales order sections and notes onto the contracts generated from the order, so the contracts keep the same headings and comments as the quote. Each section appears on the contract of the products it covers, in the original order. This shows on the generated contract lines.

name: product_contract_variable_quantity
summary: Sets default variable quantity settings, meaning the quantity type and formula, on contract products. Sales order lines and the contracts generated from them then start with the right variable quantity rule. The defaults are set on the product form.

name: subscription_oca
summary: Adds subscriptions that generate recurring invoices or orders on a schedule set by a template, such as daily or monthly. Subscriptions are managed with stages, lines and close reasons, and products can be marked as subscribable so that selling them creates a subscription. Invoices generated by a subscription are linked back to it.

name: account_credit_control
summary: Helps accounting staff chase overdue customer payments. A Credit Control Run for a chosen date generates a follow-up line for each overdue invoice, based on policies with escalating levels such as e-mail or letter, and lines can be sent, printed or marked. Customers can have a payment promise and next action noted, under Invoicing, Credit Control.

name: account_credit_control_attach_invoice
summary: When a credit control summary, such as a reminder letter or email, is printed or sent, the detailed customer invoice report is merged into the same PDF so the customer sees the outstanding invoices. The invoice report to attach is chosen in the accounting settings. This needs the credit control module.

name: account_credit_control_queue_job
summary: Sends credit control emails as background jobs in batches, instead of all at once. The batch size is set in the accounting settings. This keeps large reminder runs from timing out.

name: account_financial_risk
summary: Adds a Financial Risk tab to customers where credit limits can be set for draft invoices, open invoices and unpaid balances. If a customer exceeds a limit, their new invoices cannot be validated unless the user has the Financial Risk Manager right. Credit information can optionally be shown in the customer portal.

name: account_invoice_overdue_reminder
summary: Sends overdue invoice reminders to customers by email, letter or phone from a wizard under Invoicing, Customers, Overdue Invoice Remind. It keeps a history of every reminder per invoice, with results and notes, and is simple enough for staff without accounting skills. Reminders handle multiple currencies and show a total per currency.

name: account_invoice_overdue_warn
summary: Shows a warning banner on the customer form when the customer has overdue invoices, with the number of invoices, the total overdue amount and a link to see them. The banner also appears on the customer's contacts, and amounts are in company currency.

name: account_invoice_overdue_warn_sale
summary: Adds the same overdue invoice banner to quotations and sales orders, so salespeople see that the invoicing customer has overdue invoices before confirming. It needs the overdue warning module, and shows the count and total overdue amount with a link to the invoices.

name: account_payment_return_financial_risk
summary: Ties returned payments into a customer's financial risk. Returned payments add to the customer's risk amount, and a customer over the limit cannot confirm new sales orders. It is set up the same way as Financial Risk, with an extra option to include payment returns.

name: partner_risk_insurance
summary: Adds a Credit Insurance tab on customers to record the credit insurer, policy, insured credit limit and coverage percentage. Invoices can be marked as insured by a credit policy, and a wizard lists invoices sorted by risk. It is meant for businesses that insure customer debt.

name: partner_risk_insurance_product_sticker_invoice_report
summary: Prints an insurance company logo as a sticker on customer invoices when the invoice is covered by credit insurance. The sticker is set up per insurer and per insured state. It appears on the printed invoice report.

name: sale_financial_risk
summary: Extends customer financial risk to sales orders. The risk includes confirmed sales orders not yet invoiced, and a customer over the limit cannot confirm a new sales order. Each sales order line shows its own risk amount.

name: sale_financial_risk_info
summary: Shows the customer's credit use on sales orders in an info box, with total risk, credit limit, percentage used and the amount remaining. The wording of the box can be customized through a system parameter. It is visible on the sales order form.

name: sale_payment_sheet_financial_risk
summary: Lets sale payment sheet amounts that are collected but not yet reconciled reduce a customer's financial risk. When the option is turned on, the deducted amounts are shown grouped by risk type. It suits sales teams that collect payment in the field.

name: stock_financial_risk
summary: Blocks stock transfers, such as deliveries, for customers who are over their financial risk limit. A user who tries to transfer goods for such a customer gets an error. This is useful when goods should not ship to customers who owe too much.

name: website_sale_financial_risk
summary: Adds an On Credit payment method to the online store. Customers with enough remaining credit can place an order paid on credit, and the order is confirmed automatically. Credit limits are the same as those in Financial Risk.

name: dms
summary: The core Document Management System. Users store, organize and browse files in folders with tags and categories, directly inside Odoo, using the Documents view. Folders and files can be shared with portal users or through a tokenized link, and files can be kept in the database, as attachments or on the file system.

name: dms_auto_classification
summary: Uploads a zip file of documents and sorts each file into the right folder using filename and folder patterns from a classification template. You analyze the zip first to preview the results, then classify to create the documents. It is found under Documents, Auto Classification.

name: dms_field
summary: Creates a folder tree for a record, such as a customer or contact, so each record gets its own documents area. A DMS tab appears on the record form, and the folder layout comes from an embedded DMS template. Developers can add this to any model.

name: dms_field_auto_classification
summary: Combines zip file auto classification with embedded DMS, so uploaded files are sorted into the folders of the matching record. For example, a file can be matched to a customer by a number in its filename. It is found under Documents, Auto Classification.

name: dms_user_role
summary: Connects document access groups to user roles, so everyone with a given role automatically gets access to the matching document folders. A Roles tab is added to access groups. It requires the roles module.

name: hr_dms_field
summary: Adds a Documents tab to employee forms, with a folder structure created automatically for each employee from the file templates you define. Employees can see their own documents if the setting allows it. It is found on the employee form.

name: web_editor_media_dialog_dms
summary: Lets users insert images or links to files from the document management system into HTML fields in the web editor, such as product descriptions or website pages. Typing /image opens the media dialog, where the DMS tab offers the files. Files can optionally be shared with public users.

name: product_alias
summary: Lets you give a product variant an alternative name, called an alias, based on its attribute value combination, such as a sales or marketing name. Aliases are defined on the product template and linked to the variants. It is used for catalog and e-commerce naming.

name: product_template_multi_link
summary: Links one product to others as cross-sell suggestions, such as an add-on, or up-sell suggestions, such as a higher-end model. Links are managed under Sales, Configuration, Products, Product Links, or from the product form, and can be used to sync with an e-commerce site.

name: product_template_multi_link_date_span
summary: Adds start and end dates to product links, so a cross-sell or up-sell suggestion is only active for a set period. Some link types can require a start date.

name: product_variant_multi_link
summary: Extends product links down to individual variants, so a specific variant, such as one particular color, can be linked to another product or variant. You set the template first, then pick the variant.

name: website_sale_acquirer_confirm_order
summary: Automatically confirms the sales order when a customer pays with a payment method marked Confirm Order Automatically, so these orders skip manual confirmation. The option is set on the payment method.

name: website_sale_attribute_filter_form_submit
summary: Makes shop attribute filters apply only when the shopper clicks Submit, instead of applying on every click. Shoppers can pick several filters before seeing results. Only attribute filters are affected, and the option is turned on from the website editor.

name: website_sale_b2x_alt_price
summary: Shows an alternative price next to the main price in the online shop. On a B2B shop the price with tax is shown alongside the price without tax, and on a B2C shop the reverse. Discounts are included and update when the shopper picks variants, and the display can be turned on or off per website.

name: website_sale_barcode_search
summary: Lets shoppers find products on the website by typing or scanning a product barcode in the shop search box. It needs no setup beyond installing it.

name: website_sale_cart_expire
summary: Automatically cancels online shopping carts that have had no activity after a set delay, which is configured in the website settings. This clears out abandoned carts so they do not stay open as quotes.

name: website_sale_category_breadcrumb
summary: Shows the full chain of parent product categories as breadcrumbs on the shop, along with any extra categories a product belongs to. Installing it and refreshing the page is all that is needed.

name: website_sale_charge_payment_fee
summary: Adds a fee for paying with a chosen online payment method, such as a card surcharge. When a shopper picks that method, a fee line is added to the online order. The fee can be a fixed amount or a percentage and is set on the payment method.

name: website_sale_checkout_country_vat
summary: On checkout, the VAT country code is picked from a country dropdown separately from the VAT number, so the number is checked without a country prefix. Shoppers are guided to choose a country, and the default comes from the website, the public user or the company.

name: website_sale_checkout_skip_payment
summary: Lets selected logged-in customers finish checkout without a payment step. The quotation is emailed to them and set to Quotation Sent. It is turned on per customer in the sales settings, and a custom message can be shown on the website.

name: website_sale_comparison_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices on the product comparison pages when prices are hidden on the shop. It extends the hide price feature to comparisons.

name: website_sale_empty_cart
summary: Adds an Empty Cart button to the website shopping cart, so a shopper can remove all products in one click. It can be turned on or off per website in the website settings.

name: website_sale_hide_empty_category
summary: Hides product categories on the shop that have no products, including parent categories whose children are all empty, in the top category bar and elsewhere. The behavior can be switched in the web editor.

name: website_sale_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices on the online shop, including on the product page, in search results and in recently viewed products. Prices can be hidden for everyone by default or set per customer, and a custom message can replace the price. Buying hidden products is restricted.

name: website_sale_order_shipping_modification
summary: Lets portal customers change the delivery address on a quotation they received, from the Quotations page of the customer portal. They can pick an existing delivery address of their company or add a new one, limited to the allowed addresses.

name: website_sale_order_type
summary: Makes website orders use the sales order type. The order type set on a customer's contact applies to the orders they place online, and a website can have its own order type that takes precedence. It is useful when online orders need a special order type.

name: website_sale_product_assortment
summary: Restricts which products appear on the online shop using product assortments. A website filter can hide products that are not in the assortment, or leave them visible. It is configured on the assortment's website availability setting.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_filter_category
summary: Groups the shop's attribute filters under their attribute categories, such as Size or Color, as collapsible sections. Categories and whether they show folded are set under Website, eCommerce, Products, Attribute Categories.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_filter_order
summary: Moves the attribute values that are currently selected to the top of each filter list on the shop, so active choices are easy to see. It is turned on from the web editor's Customize tab.

name: website_sale_product_attribute_value_filter_existing
summary: Hides attribute values in shop filters when no product variant uses them. This keeps the filter list to options that actually lead to products.

name: website_sale_product_brand
summary: Adds a shop filter by product brand, with brands assigned to products. A brand can be unpublished to hide it from the online store. Brands are managed under Website, eCommerce, Product brands.

name: website_sale_product_description
summary: Adds a separate HTML description for the online store on each product, shown on the shop product page in place of the internal sales description. It is edited on the product form.

name: website_sale_product_detail_attribute_image
summary: Shows attribute images, names and values on the shop product page. An attribute can have a website image and an alternative name, and each value can have one too. An attribute is shown only when it is published on the website.

name: website_sale_product_eprel
summary: Shows the EU energy label and product information sheet links from the EPREL database on the online product page. It relies on the EPREL data stored on the product.

name: website_sale_product_item_cart_custom_qty
summary: Lets shoppers choose a quantity directly on product cards in the shop list and add that amount to the cart, without opening the product page. It is enabled through the web editor's Add to Cart option on product items.

name: website_sale_product_minimal_price
summary: On the shop list, products with variants show a From price based on the lowest variant price, and the list can be sorted by that minimal price. The product page still shows the price of the chosen variant.

name: website_sale_product_reference_displayed
summary: Shows products in the shop with their internal reference included in the name, such as an SKU, so shoppers can see product codes on listings. It can be turned on or off per template and per website.

name: website_sale_product_sort
summary: Sets a default sort order for the shop product list, such as by price or name, per website. Other modules can add extra sort options.

name: website_sale_require_legal
summary: Requires shoppers to accept legal terms before entering a new address at checkout, and logs the acceptance on the customer and on the sales order. The terms come from the legal pages set up on the website. It is turned on from the web editor.

name: website_sale_secondary_unit
summary: Lets online customers buy products in secondary units of measure, such as boxes or pallets, as well as the base unit. Secondary units are set on the product's website page and appear as a choice in the shop. The base unit can be disabled so that only secondary units can be bought.

name: website_sale_stock_available
summary: Uses the Available quantity instead of the Free to Use quantity for stock messages and cart limits on the shop, for products set to prevent sales when out of stock. Shoppers cannot buy more than the available quantity.

name: website_sale_stock_list_preview
summary: Shows stock availability on product cards in the shop list, so shoppers see stock status before opening a product. It appears when the Add to Cart option is turned on in the web editor.

name: website_sale_stock_provisioning_date
summary: Shows the next expected restock date on the product page for products that are out of stock. It is turned on per product in the eCommerce tab of the product form.

name: website_sale_suggest_create_account
summary: Suggests that shoppers log in or create an account in the cart without forcing them to, and keeps the Process Checkout button unhighlighted so guest checkout still works. This avoids duplicate customer records from one-time buyers.

name: website_sale_tax_toggle
summary: Adds a toggle on the shop so shoppers can switch prices between tax included and tax excluded. The default is set per website in the website settings.

name: website_sale_vat_required
summary: Makes the VAT number a required field on the checkout form, and rejects a missing or invalid VAT with an error. It suits B2B shops that need tax numbers on every order.

name: website_sale_wishlist_hide_price
summary: Hides product prices on the wishlist pages when prices are hidden on the shop. It extends the hide price feature to wishlists.

name: website_sale_wishlist_keep
summary: Keeps the option Add to cart but keep it in my wishlist checked, so it stays selected after the shopper leaves the wishlist. It is turned on from the web editor's Customize tab.

name: website_snippet_product_category
summary: Adds a Product Category block to the website builder that shows selected eCommerce categories as a scrolling strip with images. Categories are chosen individually and can optionally be limited to certain websites.

name: base_territory
summary: Technical base module. It defines a territory structure of regions, districts and branches, each with a manager, and lets countries and ZIP codes be assigned to territories. Records are created under Settings, Users and Companies and are used by field service and sales.

name: fieldservice
summary: The core Field Service app for scheduling and tracking on-site work orders at customer locations. It covers locations, workers, equipment, teams and order stages, with orders viewable as kanban, calendar and map views from the Field Service app.

name: fieldservice_account
summary: Links field service orders to customer invoices, so each order shows the invoices billed for it. Stages can be marked as invoiceable, and invoices show their related orders. It appears on the order and invoice forms.

name: fieldservice_account_payment
summary: Lets a field worker register a customer payment from a field service order while on site, choosing the payment method and amount. Payments are linked to the order and counted on it.

name: fieldservice_activity
summary: Adds a checklist of activities to field service orders, which can be pre-filled from order templates. Workers work through the activities on each order, and required activities are tracked. It is set up under Field Service, Configuration, Manage Order Activities.

name: fieldservice_agreement
summary: Links field service orders to service agreements, and adds a Service Orders smart button on each agreement to see its jobs. The agreement also shows its linked locations and equipment count.

name: fieldservice_agreement_repair
summary: Connects repair orders to agreements through the equipment, so you can see which repairs an agreement covers. It is relevant when repairs are part of a service agreement.

name: fieldservice_availability
summary: Technical base for scheduling availability. It defines blackout days (closed dates), blackout groups, stress days (busy dates) and delivery time ranges, under Field Service, Configuration, Scheduling. It does nothing on its own until other modules use these records.

name: fieldservice_calendar
summary: Creates a calendar meeting for each field service order, with the assigned worker as an attendee. The team's calendar user owns the events, and each meeting links back to its order.

name: fieldservice_crm
summary: Lets sales create field service orders from CRM opportunities, for example to survey a site before quoting. An opportunity gets a Create FSM Order button and an FS Orders smart button. It is used from the CRM app.

name: fieldservice_equipment_stock
summary: Creates field service equipment records automatically when serial-numbered products are moved in stock on configured operation types, such as deliveries or receipts. This lets you track which equipment is installed where. It is set on products and operation types.

name: fieldservice_equipment_warranty
summary: Adds warranty start and end dates, plus warranty duration and type, to field service equipment, based on the product's warranty settings. It shows the warranty status on each equipment record.

name: fieldservice_fleet
summary: Links field service vehicles to Fleet vehicles and field workers to Fleet drivers. An existing Fleet vehicle can be converted into a field service vehicle, and existing service vehicles get matching Fleet records when the module is installed.

name: fieldservice_geoengine
summary: Shows field service locations and orders on a map, colored by stage, using OpenStreetMap through the geo engine. Each location is placed using its address. The map views are on the Field Service dashboard and the locations.

name: fieldservice_kanban_info
summary: Shows the scheduled time range, customer address and phone numbers directly on field service kanban cards, so workers see key job details without opening the order. The time format can be set in the settings.

name: fieldservice_maintenance
summary: Connects field service orders with maintenance requests and equipment, so maintenance can be scheduled and performed on site. A field service order of the maintenance type creates a maintenance request, and equipment can have a maintenance schedule.

name: fieldservice_portal
summary: Lets portal customers see the field service orders at their locations and each order's current stage. Each stage can be made visible or hidden in the portal.

name: fieldservice_project
summary: Creates field service orders from a project or project task, and links them back to it. The Service Orders tab appears on projects and tasks.

name: fieldservice_recurring
summary: Creates repeating field service orders, such as weekly or monthly visits. The recurrence is set with frequency rules, for example every second Monday, and a scheduled job creates the future orders. It is found under Field Service, Operations, Recurring Orders.

name: fieldservice_repair
summary: Links repair orders to field service orders for equipment that is repaired on site. Choosing the Repair type on an order with an equipment creates a repair order, and the equipment's parts can be added, replaced or removed.

name: fieldservice_repair_order_template
summary: Pre-fills the repair orders created from field service orders using a repair order template, which is chosen on a field service template. It is set under Field Service, Master Data, Templates.

name: fieldservice_route
summary: Groups each worker's field service orders into a sorted daily route. When an order is assigned and scheduled, a day route for that worker and date is created automatically. Routes have a maximum number of orders, days and territories, and are set under Field Service, Master Data, Routes.

name: fieldservice_route_availability
summary: Blocks scheduling orders on blackout days for routes that use a blackout group. Trying to set a scheduled start (ETA) on a blackout date shows an error. Blackout groups are set on the route.

name: fieldservice_sale
summary: Lets you sell field services from sales orders. Confirming a sales order with a field service product creates field service orders, and the sales line's delivered quantity is updated once the order is completed. A field service location can be set on the sales order.

name: fieldservice_sale_agreement
summary: Copies the agreement from a sales order onto the field service orders it creates. It is a bridge between the sale agreement and field service agreement modules.

name: fieldservice_sale_agreement_equipment_stock
summary: Copies the agreement from a sales order onto the equipment created from that sale, so the agreement follows the installed equipment. It is a bridge between sales agreements, field service and stock equipment.

name: fieldservice_sale_recurring
summary: Lets you sell recurring field services. Confirming a sales order with a recurring service product creates the recurring field service orders, linked to the sales line, using the product's recurring template.

name: fieldservice_sale_recurring_agreement
summary: Links recurring field service tasks to agreements, so the sales orders generated from them get the agreement set automatically. The agreement set on a recurring task is carried onto each sales order it creates.

name: fieldservice_sale_stock
summary: Links the delivery pickings from a sales order to the field service order it creates, so stock moves for storable products appear on the job. Stock sold per sale order is delivered as part of the service.

name: fieldservice_sale_stock_route
summary: Schedules field service orders created from sales onto a route day automatically. Confirming the order requires a location with a route, a worker and route days. A Postpone Delivery button moves an order to the next route day, and routes can have a Force Schedule option that allows any day.

name: fieldservice_size
summary: Records sizes, such as area or item count, on field service locations and orders. The order size fills in from the location's size for that order type, which helps with route time planning and stock planning.

name: fieldservice_skill
summary: Limits which workers can be assigned to an order by their skills and levels. Categories and templates set the required skills, and the worker list is filtered by skill and by the location's territory. Skills are set on categories, workers and territories.

name: fieldservice_stage_server_action
summary: Runs a server action automatically when a field service order moves into a chosen stage, such as sending a notification or creating a record. It is configured per stage under Field Service, Configuration, Stages.

name: fieldservice_stage_validation
summary: Stops an order, worker, location or equipment from moving to a stage until chosen fields are filled in, such as actual end date or resolution notes. The required fields are set per stage, and a validation error is shown if one is empty.

name: fieldservice_stock
summary: Connects inventory to field service. Locations and territories can have an inventory location or warehouse, and stock pickings and moves are linked to the job. Related transfers can be validated automatically when an order completes.

name: fieldservice_subcontracting
summary: Creates a draft purchase order to a subcontractor when a field service order is assigned to a subcontractor worker and moved to the set stage. It keeps the purchase order's expected arrival in sync with the order schedule and updates delivered quantities from timesheets. Subcontractors are marked on partners.

name: fieldservice_timeline
summary: Shows field service orders on a timeline view, sorted by their latest request date, in a new menu under Field Service, Operations. It adds a visual schedule of orders on the web timeline.

name: fieldservice_timesheet
summary: Lets workers record the time spent on field service orders with timesheets, and shows the timesheet entries on each order. Entries also appear in the timesheet reports.

name: fieldservice_vehicle
summary: Manages field service vehicles and assigns them to workers, and each order can record which vehicle is used. Vehicles are set up under Field Service, Master Data, Vehicles.

name: helpdesk_mgmt
summary: The core Helpdesk app for handling customer support tickets. Users create tickets, assign them to teams and members, move them through stages, and organize them with categories, tags and channels on a kanban dashboard. Customers can submit and follow tickets through the website portal.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_activity
summary: Lets helpdesk agents create an activity, such as a call or meeting, on any linked record directly from a ticket, and moves the ticket to a new stage when that activity is done. The available models and the done stage are set per team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_crm
summary: Converts a helpdesk ticket into a CRM opportunity, copying the ticket details and messages, and keeps the two linked. A wizard lets you pick the salesperson and sales team. The button is on the ticket form.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice
summary: Creates field service orders from a helpdesk ticket and shows their status on the ticket. A ticket can only be closed once all of its linked service orders are closed. Service orders are managed in the ticket's Service Orders tab.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice_equipment
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to field service equipment, so each ticket shows the equipment it concerns and each equipment record shows its tickets. It appears on the ticket form and the equipment form.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice_equipment_warranty
summary: Shows the equipment's warranty start and end dates on the helpdesk ticket, so agents can see at a glance whether a complaint is under warranty. The dates appear on the ticket form.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_fieldservice_project
summary: Passes a helpdesk ticket's project and task on to any field service order created from that ticket. The order is then linked to the same project and task as the ticket.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_mail_autogenerated_header
summary: Stops the stage welcome email from being sent back when a ticket comes in from an automatic reply, such as an out-of-office message. This prevents mail loops between the helpdesk and the sender.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_merge
summary: Adds a wizard to merge several helpdesk tickets into one, either into a new ticket or into an existing one. It is opened from the ticket list view.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_portal_follower
summary: Lets customers add email addresses as followers of a ticket from the website portal, so colleagues get updates. The addresses are entered comma-separated in an Emails in Copy field.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_project
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to projects and tasks, with a default project per team. Projects and tasks show a ticket count, and tickets can be linked to a task. It appears on the ticket form and the project forms.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_project_domain
summary: Limits which projects and tasks a helpdesk user can pick on a ticket, using a domain set on the company, on each team, or as Python code. A team uses its own domain if one is set, otherwise the company-wide domain applies. It is configured in the Helpdesk settings and on each team.

name: Project Filtering
summary: Part of the helpdesk project domain feature, not a separate module. It limits the projects a helpdesk user can select on a ticket: the team's domain is used if set, otherwise the company-wide domain, and if neither is set all projects are available.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_rating
summary: Lets customers rate the help they received on a ticket. A rating request email goes out at the stage you set, and tickets show the percentage of positive ratings.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sale
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to sales orders, so a ticket can have several orders and each order shows its tickets. Each ticket has a Sales Order button that opens the linked orders.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sale_project
summary: Keeps a helpdesk ticket's project in step with its sales order. If the order's project changes and the ticket has no project, the ticket takes that project. It is a technical link with no separate screens.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_sla
summary: Adds service level agreements to tickets, with response and resolution deadlines per SLA based on working hours. Kanban cards and the ticket form show whether each deadline is met or missed. SLAs are set up under Helpdesk, Configuration, SLA.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_stage_validation
summary: Stops a ticket from moving to a stage until chosen fields are filled in, such as resolution notes. The required fields are set per stage, and the user sees a validation error if one is missing.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_template
summary: Pre-fills the description of a new ticket from a template tied to its category, for example a checklist for a common issue. Categories are configured per team.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_timesheet
summary: Lets helpdesk agents log timesheet hours against tickets, with planned, consumed and remaining hours and progress shown on each ticket. Timesheets are enabled per team and can use a default project.

name: helpdesk_mgmt_timesheet_sale
summary: Lets a helpdesk ticket be tied to a sales order and sales order line, so the hours logged on the ticket can be billed through that line. Tickets can be marked billable.
